question: Co-operative societies are primarily accountable to which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Co-operative Society Members**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Co-operative societies operate on the principle of mutual benefit and are primarily accountable to their members, who are both owners and stakeholders.
 
• Members of a co-operative society participate in decision-making and elect representatives to manage the society's operations.
 
• The accountability structure ensures democratic governance, with each member having equal voting rights regardless of their financial contribution.
